prompt: Review an unseen distributed-state design and incident packet. State its actual failure, consistency, replication, ordering, time, leadership, repair and external-effect contracts; diagnose one injected partition or leader-loss incident; then redesign it when the reviewer changes one major correctness, latency, availability, geography or cost constraint.
deliverables: Business operations invariants acknowledgement meanings and state owners.
Crash omission timing and trust failure model with uncertainty boundaries.
Partition key replica role placement membership and quorum map.
Consistency and session guarantee for each operation.
Leader election commit apply and client-routing trace.
Physical/logical clock lease timeout epoch and fencing analysis.
Replication lag conflict versioning anti-entropy and repair design.
Partition quorum-loss split-brain and ambiguous-effect incident timeline.
Capacity tail-latency storage network observability security and cost envelope.
Changed-constraint alternatives recovery validation and cleanup proof.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies an unfamiliar sanitized topology history and fault packet.
No production system credential live endpoint shared network destructive clock change or unapproved fault injection.
Every guarantee is named at operation scope with an observable history or state test.
The learner distinguishes safety from liveness and message delay from proven process failure.
Quorum arithmetic includes membership configuration and failure-domain placement.
Timestamps are not used to elect truth without a justified clock model.
Every stale actor is fenced at each external state owner.
Recovery preserves committed history and reconciles ambiguous business effects.
Reviewer changes one major constraint after the first design and observes adaptation.
Reviewer scores delayed explanation safety judgment evidence quality and exact cleanup.
